definitions.explanation: The quality of being morally right and fair; adherence to moral principles.

examples.japanese: {正義|せいぎ}のために{戦|たたか}う。
{正義|せいぎ}は{必|かなら}ず{勝|か}つ。
{彼|かれ}は{正義感|せいぎかん}が{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: He has a strong sense of justice.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正義|せいぎ}のために (for the sake of justice)
- {正義感|せいぎかん} (sense of justice)
- {正義|せいぎ}の{味方|みかた} (ally of justice)
- {社会|しゃかい}{正義|せいぎ} (social justice)

RELATED TERMS:
- {公正|こうせい} - fairness, impartiality
- {倫理|りんり} - ethics
- {道徳|どうとく} - morality
